sloka: अन्योन्यं प्रममन्थुस्ते विविशुर्नगरं भयात् ।पृष्ठतस्ते सुसम्मूढाः प्रेक्षमाणा मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६.५६.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: anyonyaṁ pramamanthuste viviśurnagaraṁ bhayāt ।pṛṣṭhataste susammūḍhāḥ prekṣamāṇā muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6.56.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Again, and again looking back in fear, covertly, bewildered, crushing one another, they went into the Lanka city.
